mutation: verifyDataset() used the manifest's declared digest as the computed one instead of recomputing it from the samples, so a dataset edited after its manifest was written verified clean.
performedBy: manual mutation during the dataset governance milestone. The first attempt exposed a defect in the test rather than the code: emitEvidence sat after the assertion, so a failing run threw first and left the previous passing record in place. Moving the emit before the assertion made the mutation visible, and the record then flipped to passed:false.
